scientific.question: Does high new-CAD signed stress error come chiefly from sign disagreement or spatial magnitude? Choose the next structural GeoBC experiment from evidence, not further Hash tuning.
scientific.prerequisite: Genuine completed paired-seed knownDEV readout v83 with all240 immutable finite predictions and actual barrier/GT60once; true terminal/exact process exits. Bind real terminal and cache identities before execution.
scientific.targets: Original signed S in MPa from existing aligned physicalGT cache; originalU untouched; no guessed stress-sign exporter convention or constitutive scalar equation.
diagnostics: Actual full-node signed stress relativeL2/hotspot, signed correlation and field norm ratio
Non-deployable sign oracle: abs(predictedS)*sign(trueS), including true0 as0, isolates impact of wrong signs without changing observed labels
Non-deployable magnitude oracle: abs(trueS)*sign(predictedS), predicted0 yields0, isolates sign limitations if magnitudes were known
Positive-vs-negative truth subset energy, wrong-sign contribution to squared error, full-node sign disagreement and nearzero energy documented; never replace signed evaluation by absoluteS
Fixed eachload20/CAD20/seed paired summaries and oracle gains; no statistical independence or blindfinal claims
scientific.memory_policy: One cachedGT case and four corresponding prediction fields at a time; no GPU, rawCSV/H5, checkpoint body, scalerfit, DEV selection change, or training.
scientific.selection_policy: These truth-conditioned oracles diagnose a bottleneck and cannot be used as deployable correction, model selection score or achieved solver error. Do not precommit a sign head unless the actual decomposition warrants it. If signs do not explain the remaining error, explore spatial conditioning or physical response representation rather than rescue Hash with small hyperparameter changes.
